notes: Adds Guided Firearm Setup for new and existing firearms, including magazine quantity, dedicated/shared/unknown usage, compatibility selection, and quick creation of other related gear.
Rerunning Guided Setup recognizes existing magazine inventory and asks for additional magazines instead of blindly duplicating records.
Shared magazines create or reuse compatibility relationships while dedicated magazines stay assigned to the selected firearm.
Tightens Ammunition reserve-card artwork spacing and enlarges the horizontal cartridge image without increasing card height.
